Hi, I live near Timberline Dr and Evergreen Way. Our sewer lines and school classrooms are already at capacity, and fourplexes on every lot will make that worse. We bought here for the neighborhood as it is. I'm not against housing, I'm against doing it without a plan. I OPPOSE the fourplex reform as written. Please phase it in with an infrastructure plan. Dear Council Office, The senior center near us cut its hours to three days a week and my father now eats lunch alone most days. I've been in this city 22 years and I've never written before. Please restore the full senior center schedule. Sincerely, [name removed]

Dear Councilmember, My solar permit has been pending for twelve weeks for a standard rooftop system. I'm a teacher and a parent of 2. I'm paying rent and a loan on a space I can't use. Please fix the permit backlog and set a real turnaround time. Thanks, [name removed] San José, CA 95118

Hello, Package theft and car break-ins on our block have doubled this year. I work nights, so I see this at 6 a.m. most days. People are scared to park on the street. I SUPPORT more patrols and community service officers in our area. [name removed]

I'm genuinely torn. We need the tax revenue and the land is industrial. But I also worry about water and traffic on Zanker. I guess I'd support it IF there were strong water-recycling requirements and a community benefit agreement. Without those I lean no. Just sharing honestly.
its freezing cold water only at our building off tully. been weeks. management says 'working on it'. nothing. i oppose how the city lets slumlords ignore this. please help us.

To the City Council, We live just off Quail Crest Way near Hollow Lake Way. My grown kids can't afford to live in the city they grew up in, and fourplexes are a reasonable fix. Every older neighborhood here already has duplexes and nobody notices them. We need housing near jobs and transit. I SUPPORT the fourplex reform. Please approve it. We will keep watching how the council votes. Regards, [nam

To the City Council, I coach youth soccer and the families ask me about this. I live near Curtner Ave and Fairhill Ln. Our sewer lines and school classrooms are already at capacity, and fourplexes on every lot will make that worse. I'm not against housing, I'm against doing it without a plan. Please vote no on citywide fourplexes. Thanks, [name removed]

Dear Councilmember, Half the streetlights along our walk to school are out, and the copper wiring was stolen again. Our family has been in River Glen for 23 years. We moved here in 2005 and we'd like to stay. I SUPPORT funding a faster repair crew and theft-proof wiring. Thank you, [name removed]

Hello, The building's front door lock has been broken for months and strangers sleep in the stairwell. My neighbor uses a wheelchair, so this matters a lot. I SUPPORT proactive rental inspections so tenants don't have to fight alone. Thank you, [name removed]

The air near my place by 101 is visibly hazy and my kid's asthma is worse. I SUPPORT a sound/air wall and more trees along the corridor. Please prioritize freeway-adjacent neighborhoods for air quality help.

Dear Councilmember, I own a small business near Montgomery Ln and Gerdts Dr. My wife and I talk about this every week. The vacant lot next to us has become a dump site for appliances and bags of trash. I SUPPORT more dumping enforcement and faster cleanup. Respectfully, [name removed]

Hello, The Blossom Hill parcel should be housing or a park, not more empty retail. I've been in this city 12 years and I've never written before. Please deny the Blossom Hill rezoning application. Thank you, [name removed] Chesbro resident

To the City Council, I live by Canoas Garden Avenue and Almaden Expressway with my family. I'm retired and I walk the neighborhood every morning. Our building changed owners and the first letter we got was a rent increase. Please vote YES on the rent cap amendment. Best, [name removed]

Hello, My neighbor's catalytic converter was cut off in broad daylight last week. Nobody even called back about the report. I'm a pharmacist and a parent of 3. I SUPPORT more patrols and community service officers in our area. Regards, [name removed]

Dear Mayor and Council, The heater in our unit has been broken since November and the landlord says it's not urgent. I called code enforcement and was told the wait is weeks. My daughter has asthma and it's getting worse. Please send an inspector and hold the landlord accountable. I hope this gets on someone's list. Sincerely, [name removed]
Put cameras at the known dumping spots by the creek and fine people hard. I SUPPORT enforcement. Cleanups without consequences just invite the next dump.

Alviso flooded badly before and the levees are a constant worry. Paving over more land for a data center reduces where water can go. The staff report barely mentions this. I OPPOSE the project and I'm shocked flood risk isn't front and center. Please do better by Alviso.

Everyone's talking about Story and King but my single light around the corner has been out since spring and nobody cares about one light. I support fixing the corridor but please don't forget the individual outages too. Mixed feelings about where the money goes.

Dear Councilmember, The Blossom Hill parcel should be housing or a park, not more empty retail. I coach youth soccer and the families ask me about this. My house is right at Snell Avenue and Silverberry Drive. Half the storefronts in the existing center are vacant. I OPPOSE the rezoning as proposed. [name removed]

To the City Council, I signed a lease for my bakery last winter and still can't open because the permit is stuck. I coach youth soccer and the families ask me about this. I've been a homeowner near West Hedding Street and North Bascom Avenue for 19 years. Nobody at the permit center can tell me where it is in the queue. Hello, I live by Norval Way and Lincoln Ave with my family. A pothole near the crosswalk bent the rim on my car last week. My neighbor's tire blew out on it in March. Please repave the block instead of patching it again. Respectfully, [name removed]

To the City Council, There is a pothole on our street the size of a manhole cover and it has been there since winter. I live at the corner of Clovercrest Dr and Glen Brae Ln. Cyclists have to swerve into traffic to avoid it. I OPPOSE spending on cosmetic projects while basic streets crumble. Best, [name removed]

The crossing by the elementary school has no signal and drivers do fifty through it. A crossing guard was nearly hit in September. I'm a pharmacist and a parent of 1. We asked for a traffic study two years ago. Please install a flashing beacon and a marked crosswalk this year. I hope this gets on someone's list. Sincerely, [name removed] Buena Vista resident
I SUPPORT restoring the lights but I OPPOSE a new tax or fee for it. Reprioritize the budget you already have. This is a core service — fund it from existing money, not my wallet.

I signed a lease for a café in Willow Glen in January and STILL can't open because of permit and inspection delays. I'm paying rent on an empty space. I OPPOSE how the city treats small businesses. Streamline this or waive my fees for the delay.

Dear Councilmembers, On behalf of our member employers, the North San José Business Forum writes in conditional SUPPORT of the Terra Verde investment, which activates a long-vacant industrial parcel and expands the tax base. Hello, There is a huge pothole on Alma Avenue just west of the Washington area. It is at least two feet across and deep. I've seen two cyclists nearly thrown off. I've reported it on the app three times since July. Nothing. I OPPOSE the city's pattern of ignoring the Gardner/Washington streets. Please fix this specific hole now before someone is seriously injured. [name removed]

To the City Council, I live near Chynoweth Avenue and Winfield Boulevard. There is a pile of dumped furniture and trash bags on the sidewalk that has been there two weeks. Kids have to walk around it into the street. Please clean it up and put a camera at this spot. Regards, [name removed]

Hi, Someone tried to break into our garage at 3 a.m. and police took over an hour to come. I'm a small business owner and a parent of 4. We live just off Cherry Ave near Joplin Dr. People are scared to park on the street. We put up cameras ourselves. I SUPPORT more patrols and community service officers in our area. We will keep watching how the council votes. [name removed]

We live near the corner of Mancuso Street and Redmond Avenue. The Blossom Hill parcel should be housing or a park, not more empty retail. Half the storefronts in the existing center are vacant. I OPPOSE the rezoning as proposed. I hope this gets on someone's list. Respectfully, [name removed]

Our landlord sent notices to six units saying we have to leave for renovations that never seem to happen. I rent an apartment near Hallbrook Drive and Kirk Road. I've been in this city 10 years and I've never written before. Most of us have lived here more than ten years. Please close the remodel loophole and require relocation payments. Sincerely, [name removed]

Estimados concejales, Vivimos junto a la autopista y el aire siempre está sucio. Vivimos en Vinci Park desde hace 4 años. Pedimos un muro de sonido y más árboles. Atentamente, [name removed]
